claims.how: The record states the highest spatial frequency reliably resolved by honeybees as 0.26 cycle per degree.
Each eye reaches 156 degrees back from straight ahead at the horizon, so 2 x 156 = 312 degrees.
A person's flicker fusion of 60 Hz divided by the honeybee's 200 Hz gives 0.3.
360 degrees minus the two fields of 156 degrees each (312 degrees) leaves a blind wedge of 48 degrees.

quotes.quote: the highest spatial frequency reliably resolved by the bees was 0.26 cycle deg−1
Seidl and Kaiser (1981) reported that the honeybee FOV extends down to −90° in elevation and back to −156° in azimuth (at 0° el.)
At ca. 200 Hz the FRC drops to 50%.
